## Calling a native RPC

Native services are served on the control-plane listener, not the DataBroker port: `UDB_AUTH_GRPC_ADDR`, which defaults to loopback on the DataBroker port plus 10 (50061 next to 50051). The DataBroker port answers `UNIMPLEMENTED` for them. The WebRTC peer services also listen on the peer listener.

Each table lists the scope that admits an RPC; `udb:admin` (and, for authn, authz and apikey, `udb:auth:admin`) admits every RPC. A token carries a person's role scopes only when the role sets `token_scopes`. A missing scope is refused with `PERMISSION_DENIED`, naming the method and the scope.
